verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּצֵ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ לִקְרַ֨את פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ עַל־ הָאֶ֣בֶן הָעֵ֔זֶר וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים חָנ֥וּ בַאֲפֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- šə·mū·’êl lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·ṣê yiś·rā·’êl liq·raṯ pə·liš·tîm lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·ya·ḥă·nū ‘al- hā·’e·ḇen hā·‘ê·zer ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ḥā·nū ḇa·’ă·p̄êq
verses.literal: Thus the word of Samuel came to all Israel Now the Israelites went out to meet the Philistines in battle and camped at Ebenezer while the Philistines camped at Aphek
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a palavra de Samuel a todo o Israel; e Israel saiu à peleja contra os filisteus e acampou-se junto a Ebenézer; e os filisteus se acamparam junto a Afeque.

verses.original: וַיַּעַרְכ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לִקְרַ֣את יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַתִּטֹּשׁ֙ הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַיִּנָּ֥גֶף יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּכּ֤וּ בַמַּֽעֲרָכָה֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה כְּאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ar·ḵū p̄ə·liš·tîm liq·raṯ yiś·rā·’êl wat·tiṭ·ṭōš ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yin·nā·ḡep̄ yiś·rā·’êl lip̄·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yak·kū ḇam·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh baś·śā·ḏeh kə·’ar·ba·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš
verses.literal: The Philistines arrayed themselves against Israel and as the battle spread Israel was defeated by the Philistines who struck down about four thousand men on the battlefield . . .
verses.literalPt: E os filisteus se dispuseram em ordem de batalha, para sair contra Israel; e, estendendo-se a peleja, Israel foi ferido diante dos filisteus, porque feriram na batalha, no campo, uns quatro mil homens.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א הָעָם֮ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֒ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ֣מָּה נְגָפָ֧נוּ יְהוָ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם לִפְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים נִקְחָ֧ה אֵלֵ֣ינוּ מִשִּׁלֹ֗ה אֶת־ אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְיָבֹ֣א בְקִרְבֵּ֔נוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵ֖נוּ מִכַּ֥ף אֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō hā·‘ām ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yō·mə·rū ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl lām·māh nə·ḡā·p̄ā·nū Yah·weh hay·yō·wm lip̄·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm niq·ḥāh ’ê·lê·nū miš·ši·lōh ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ Yah·weh wə·yā·ḇō ḇə·qir·bê·nū wə·yō·ši·‘ê·nū mik·kap̄ ’ō·yə·ḇê·nū
verses.literal: When the troops returned to the camp the elders of Israel asked Why has the LORD brought defeat on us before the Philistines today Let us bring . . . the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Shiloh so that it may go with us to save us from the hand of our enemies
verses.literalPt: E voltando o povo ao arraial, disseram os anciãos de Israel: Por que nos feriu o SENHOR hoje diante dos filisteus? Tragamos de Siló a arca da aliança do SENHOR, e venha no meio de nós, para que nos livre da mão de nossos inimigos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח הָעָם֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים וְשָׁ֞ם שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עֵלִ֗י עִם־ אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים חָפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ hā·‘ām ši·lōh way·yiś·’ū miš·šām ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yō·šêḇ hak·kə·ru·ḇîm wə·šām šə·nê ḇə·nê- ‘ê·lî ‘im- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās
verses.literal: So the people sent men to Shiloh and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Hosts who sits enthroned between the cherubim And the two sons of Eli Hophni and Phinehas were there with the ark of the covenant of God
verses.literalPt: Enviou, pois, o povo a Siló, e trouxeram de lá a arca da aliança do SENHOR dos Exércitos, que habita entre os querubins; e os dois filhos de Eli, Hofni e Finéias, estavam ali com a arca da aliança de Deus.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּב֨וֹא אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיָּרִ֥עוּ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַתֵּהֹ֖ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḇō·w ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yā·ri·‘ū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl tə·rū·‘āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh wat·tê·hōm hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD entered . . . the camp all the Israelites raised such a great shout that the ground shook
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, vindo a arca da aliança do SENHOR ao arraial, todo o Israel gritou com grande júbilo, até que a terra estremeceu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַתְּרוּעָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֶ֠ה ק֣וֹל הַתְּרוּעָ֧ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֛ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה הָעִבְרִ֑ים וַיֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֚י אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- qō·wl hat·tə·rū·‘āh way·yō·mə·rū meh qō·wl hat·tə·rū·‘āh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh haz·zōṯ bə·ma·ḥă·nêh hā·‘iḇ·rîm way·yê·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh bā ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: On hearing the noise of the shout the Philistines asked What is . . . this loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews And when they realized that the ark of the LORD had entered . . . the camp
verses.literalPt: E os filisteus, ouvindo a voz de júbilo, disseram: Que voz de grande júbilo é esta no arraial dos hebreus? Então souberam que a arca do SENHOR era vinda ao arraial.

verses.original: וַיִּֽרְאוּ֙ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ בָּ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ א֣וֹי לָ֔נוּ כִּ֣י לֹ֥א הָיְתָ֛ה כָּזֹ֖את אֶתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū hap·pə·liš·tîm kî ’ā·mə·rū bā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yō·mə·rū ’ō·w lā·nū kî lō hā·yə·ṯāh kā·zōṯ ’eṯ·mō·wl šil·šōm
verses.literal: the Philistines were afraid The gods have entered . . . their camp . . . they said Woe to us for nothing like this has happened before . . .
verses.literalPt: Por isso os filisteus se atemorizaram, porque diziam: Deus veio ao arraial. E diziam mais: Ai de nós! Tal nunca jamais sucedeu antes.

verses.original: א֣וֹי לָ֔נוּ מִ֣י יַצִּילֵ֔נוּ מִיַּ֛ד הָאֱלֹהִ֥ים הָאַדִּירִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֵ֧לֶּה הֵ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים הַמַּכִּ֧ים אֶת־ מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּכָל־ מַכָּ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lā·nū mî yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nū mî·yaḏ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·’ad·dî·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’êl·leh hêm hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ham·mak·kîm ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim bə·ḵāl mak·kāh bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Woe to us Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods These . . . are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Ai de nós! Quem nos livrará da mão desses grandiosos deuses? Estes são os deuses que feriram aos egípcios com todas as pragas junto ao deserto.

verses.original: הִֽתְחַזְּק֞וּ וִֽהְי֤וּ לַֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ לָעִבְרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבְד֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם לַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְנִלְחַמְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·ḥaz·zə·qū wih·yū la·’ă·nā·šîm pə·liš·tîm pen ta·‘aḇ·ḏū lā·‘iḇ·rîm ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū lā·ḵem wih·yî·ṯem la·’ă·nā·šîm wə·nil·ḥam·tem
verses.literal: Take courage and be men O Philistines Otherwise you will serve the Hebrews just as they served you Now be men and fight
verses.literalPt: Esforçai-vos, e sede homens, ó filisteus, para que porventura não venhais a servir aos hebreus, como eles serviram a vós; sede, pois, homens, e pelejai.

verses.original: וַיִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּנָּ֤גֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיָּנֻ֙סוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְאֹהָלָ֔יו וַתְּהִ֥י הַמַּכָּ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּפֹּל֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yin·nā·ḡep̄ yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·nu·sū ’îš lə·’ō·hā·lāw wat·tə·hî ham·mak·kāh gə·ḏō·w·lāh mə·’ōḏ way·yip·pōl mî·yiś·rā·’êl šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî
verses.literal: So the Philistines fought and Israel was defeated and each man fled to his tent The slaughter was very great thirty thousand foot soldiers of Israel fell
verses.literalPt: Então pelejaram os filisteus, e Israel foi ferido, fugindo cada um para a sua tenda; e foi tão grande o estrago, que caíram de Israel trinta mil homens de pé.

verses.original: וַאֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִ֖ים נִלְקָ֑ח וּשְׁנֵ֤י בְנֵֽי־ עֵלִי֙ מֵ֔תוּ חָפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hîm nil·qāḥ ū·šə·nê ḇə·nê- ‘ê·lî mê·ṯū ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās
verses.literal: The ark of God was captured and Eli’s two sons Hophni and Phinehas died
verses.literalPt: E foi tomada a arca de Deus: e os dois filhos de Eli, Hofni e Finéias, morreram.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤רָץ אִישׁ־ בִּנְיָמִן֙ מֵהַמַּ֣עֲרָכָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א שִׁלֹ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וּמַדָּ֣יו קְרֻעִ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rāṣ ’îš- bin·yā·min mê·ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh way·yā·ḇō ši·lōh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ū·mad·dāw qə·ru·‘îm wa·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘al- rō·šōw
verses.literal: That same day a Benjamite . . . ran from the battle line all the way to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dirt on his head
verses.literalPt: Então correu, da batalha, um homem de Benjamim, e chegou no mesmo dia a Siló; e trazia as vestes rotas, e terra sobre a cabeça.

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵ֠לִי יֹשֵׁ֨ב עַֽל־ הַכִּסֵּ֜א יַךְ דֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ מְצַפֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ הָיָ֤ה לִבּוֹ֙ חָרֵ֔ד עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְהָאִ֗ישׁ בָּ֚א לְהַגִּ֣יד בָּעִ֔יר וַתִּזְעַ֖ק כָּל־ הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w wə·hin·nêh ‘ê·lî yō·šêḇ ‘al- hak·kis·sê yaḵ de·reḵ mə·ṣap·peh kî- hā·yāh lib·bōw ḥā·rêḏ ‘al ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hā·’îš bā lə·hag·gîḏ bā·‘îr wat·tiz·‘aq kāl- hā·‘îr
verses.literal: When he arrived there was Eli sitting on his chair beside the road and watching because his heart trembled for the ark of God When the man entered the city to give a report the whole city cried out
verses.literalPt: E, chegando ele, eis que Eli estava assentado numa cadeira, olhando para o caminho; porquanto o seu coração estava tremendo pela arca de Deus. Entrando, pois, aquele homem a anunciar isto na cidade, toda a cidade gritou.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע עֵלִי֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַצְּעָקָ֔ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מֶ֛ה ק֥וֹל הֶהָמ֖וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה וְהָאִ֣ישׁ מִהַ֔ר וַיָּבֹ֖א וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לְעֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ‘ê·lî ’eṯ- qō·wl haṣ·ṣə·‘ā·qāh way·yō·mer meh qō·wl he·hā·mō·wn haz·zeh wə·hā·’îš mi·har way·yā·ḇō way·yag·gêḏ lə·‘ê·lî
verses.literal: Eli heard the outcry . . . and asked Why . . . this commotion So the man hurried over . . . and reported to Eli
verses.literalPt: E Eli, ouvindo os gritos, disse: Que alvoroço é esse? Então chegou aquele homem apressadamente, e veio, e o anunciou a Eli.

verses.original: וְעֵלִ֕י בֶּן־ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וְעֵינָ֣יו קָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יָכ֖וֹל לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·lî ben- tiš·‘îm ū·šə·mō·neh šā·nāh wə·‘ê·nāw qā·māh wə·lō yā·ḵō·wl lir·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now Eli was ninety-eight . . . years old . . . and his gaze was fixed because he could not . . . see
verses.literalPt: E era Eli da idade de noventa e oito anos; e estavam os seus olhos tão escurecidos, que já não podia ver.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָאִ֜ישׁ אֶל־ עֵלִ֗י אָֽנֹכִי֙ הַבָּ֣א מִן־ הַמַּעֲרָכָ֔ה וַאֲנִ֕י מִן־ הַמַּעֲרָכָ֖ה נַ֣סְתִּי הַיּ֑וֹם וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מֶֽה־ הָיָ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·’îš ’el- ‘ê·lî ’ā·nō·ḵî hab·bā min- ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh wa·’ă·nî min- ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh nas·tî hay·yō·wm way·yō·mer meh- hā·yāh had·dā·ḇār bə·nî
verses.literal: I have just come from the battle the man said to Eli I fled from there today . . . What happened . . . my son Eli asked
verses.literalPt: E disse aquele homem a Eli: Eu sou o que venho da batalha; porque eu fugi hoje da batalha. E disse ele: Que coisa sucedeu, filho meu?

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַֽמְבַשֵּׂ֜ר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָ֤ס יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לִפְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְגַ֛ם מַגֵּפָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה הָיְתָ֣ה בָעָ֑ם וְגַם־ שְׁנֵ֨י בָנֶ֜יךָ מֵ֗תוּ חָפְנִי֙ וּפִ֣ינְחָ֔ס וַאֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים נִלְקָֽחָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ham·ḇaś·śêr way·yō·mer nās yiś·rā·’êl lip̄·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm wə·ḡam mag·gê·p̄āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh hā·yə·ṯāh ḇā·‘ām wə·ḡam- šə·nê ḇā·ne·ḵā mê·ṯū ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās wa·’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm nil·qā·ḥāh
verses.literal: The messenger . . . answered Israel has fled before the Philistines and there has been a great slaughter among the people . . . Your two sons Hophni and Phinehas are both dead and the ark of God has been captured
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu o que trazia as notícias, e disse: Israel fugiu de diante dos filisteus, e houve também grande matança entre o povo; e, além disso, também teus dois filhos, Hofni e Finéias, morreram, e a arca de Deus foi tomada.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כְּהַזְכִּיר֣וֹ׀ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיִּפֹּ֣ל מֵֽעַל־ הַ֠כִּסֵּא אֲחֹ֨רַנִּ֜ית בְּעַ֣ד׀ יַ֣ד הַשַּׁ֗עַר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֤ר מַפְרַקְתּוֹ֙ וַיָּמֹ֔ת כִּֽי־ זָקֵ֥ן הָאִ֖ישׁ וְכָבֵ֑ד וְה֛וּא שָׁפַ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·haz·kî·rōw ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yip·pōl mê·‘al- hak·kis·sê ’ă·ḥō·ran·nîṯ bə·‘aḏ yaḏ haš·ša·‘ar wat·tiš·šā·ḇêr map̄·raq·tōw way·yā·mōṯ kî- zā·qên hā·’îš wə·ḵā·ḇêḏ wə·hū šā·p̄aṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: As soon as the ark of God was mentioned Eli fell backward . . . from his chair by the city gate and being old and heavy he broke his neck and died And Eli had judged Israel forty years
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, fazendo ele menção da arca de Deus, Eli caiu da cadeira para trás, ao lado da porta, e quebrou-se-lhe o pescoço e morreu; porquanto o homem era velho e pesado; e tinha ele julgado Israel quarenta anos.

verses.original: וְכַלָּת֣וֹ אֵֽשֶׁת־ פִּינְחָס֮ הָרָ֣ה לָלַת֒ וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ הַשְּׁמֻעָ֔ה אֶל־ הִלָּקַח֙ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמֵ֥ת חָמִ֖יהָ וְאִישָׁ֑הּ וַתִּכְרַ֣ע וַתֵּ֔לֶד כִּֽי־ נֶהֶפְכ֥וּ עָלֶ֖יהָ צִרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵal·lā·ṯōw ’ê·šeṯ- pî·nə·ḥās hā·rāh lā·laṯ wat·tiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- haš·šə·mu·‘āh ’el- hil·lā·qaḥ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mêṯ ḥā·mî·hā wə·’î·šāh wat·tiḵ·ra‘ wat·tê·leḏ kî- ne·hep̄·ḵū ‘ā·le·hā ṣi·re·hā
verses.literal: Now Eli’s daughter-in-law the wife of Phinehas was pregnant and about to give birth When she heard the news of the capture of God’s ark and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband she collapsed and gave birth for her labor pains overtook her
verses.literalPt: E, estando sua nora, a mulher de Finéias, grávida, e próxima ao parto, e ouvindo estas notícias, de que a arca de Deus era tomada, e de que seu sogro e seu marido morreram, encurvou-se e deu à luz; porquanto as dores lhe sobrevieram.

verses.original: וּכְעֵ֣ת מוּתָ֗הּ וַתְּדַבֵּ֙רְנָה֙ הַנִּצָּב֣וֹת עָלֶ֔יהָ אַל־ תִּֽירְאִ֖י כִּ֣י בֵ֣ן יָלָ֑דְתְּ וְלֹ֥א עָנְתָ֖ה וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥תָה לִבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·‘êṯ mū·ṯāh wat·tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇō·wṯ ‘ā·le·hā ’al- tî·rə·’î kî ḇên yā·lā·ḏət wə·lō ‘ā·nə·ṯāh wə·lō- šā·ṯāh lib·bāh
verses.literal: As she was dying the women attending to her said Do not be afraid for you have given birth to a son But she did not respond . . . or pay any heed . . .
verses.literalPt: E, ao tempo em que ia morrendo, disseram as mulheres que estavam com ela: Não temas, pois deste à luz um filho. Ela porém não respondeu, nem fez caso disso.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֣א לַנַּ֗עַר אִֽי־ כָבוֹד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר גָּלָ֥ה כָב֖וֹד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־ הִלָּקַח֙ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאֶל־ חָמִ֖יהָ וְאִישָֽׁהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā lan·na·‘ar ’î- ḵā·ḇō·wḏ lê·mōr gā·lāh ḵā·ḇō·wḏ mî·yiś·rā·’êl ’el- hil·lā·qaḥ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’el- ḥā·mî·hā wə·’î·šāh
verses.literal: And she named the boy Ichabod saying The glory has departed from Israel because the ark of God had been captured and her father-in-law and her husband had been killed
verses.literalPt: E chamou ao menino Icabode, dizendo: De Israel se foi a glória! Porque a arca de Deus foi tomada, e por causa de seu sogro e de seu marido.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר גָּלָ֥ה כָב֖וֹד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י נִלְקַ֖ח אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer gā·lāh ḵā·ḇō·wḏ mî·yiś·rā·’êl kî nil·qaḥ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: The glory has departed from Israel she said for the ark of God has been captured
verses.literalPt: E disse: De Israel a glória é levada presa; pois é tomada a arca de Deus.
